verdict.rationale: Baseten exposes an OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible Model APIs endpoint callable via API key and SDKs, with documented function calling, structured outputs, streaming, async inference, rate limits, and usage/monitoring endpoints, plus a CLI (Truss) for deployment automation — all clearly documented for programmatic/agentic use. missing for 10: no discoverable formal OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found 404s across candidate paths), and no independent third-party validation of API robustness beyond vendor docs.
